summary: Verified Emergent-managed Google sign-in integration end-to-end for Dental Hub Pro. Added /app/backend/tests/test_google_auth.py (8 tests, 100% pass) covering: POST /api/auth/google/session (400 missing X-Session-ID, 401 invalid session), STAFF_EMAILS allowlist code-path at server.py:322, session management per /app/auth_testing.md (user+user_sessions injection in Mongo, Bearer + cookie auth on /api/auth/me, invalid Bearer -> 401), staff login (vsv.visakhapatnam@gmail.com / DentalHub@2026 -> role=admin + session_token) and logout invalidation (POST /auth/logout then /auth/me -> 401), non-staff login 403. Frontend: /login renders [data-testid=login-google] 'Continue with Google'; clicking it triggers window.location to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>%2Fdashboard (verified via code at Login.jsx:35-36 and observed redirect chain terminating at accounts.google.com with redirect_uri=demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/callback). Visiting /dashboard#session_id=fake123 mounts AuthCallback (shows 'Signing you in…' spinner), attempts POST /auth/google/session (401 as expected), and cleanly redirects to /login — no crash/white-screen (login page re-rendered, confirmed by screenshot).

detail.TestGoogleSessionEndpoint::test_staff_ga: PASSED (STAFF_EMAILS + 403 'team members' present in google_session handler ~line 322)
detail.TestSessionInjection::test_bearer_auth_m: PASSED (Mongo-injected user+session_token works with Authorization: Bearer, _id and password_hash excluded)
detail.TestSessionInjection::test_cookie_auth_m: PASSED (same token works via httpOnly cookie session_token)

ui_smoke.login_page: [data-testid=login-google] present with text 'Continue with Google'; staff-only amber banner [data-testid=login-staff-note] visible
ui_smoke.google_button_click: Browser navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>%2Fdashboard (chain ends at accounts.google.com with redirect_uri=demobackend.emergentagent.com/auth/v1/env/oauth/callback as expected by Emergent playbook)
ui_smoke.auth_callback_route: /dashboard#session_id=fake123 -> AuthCallback renders 'Signing you in…' spinner, POSTs /auth/google/session (401), redirects to /login cleanly (no white-screen, login page re-rendered)

critical_code_review_comments: Emergent Google OAuth implementation is correct and matches the playbook: synchronous hash detection in App Shell -> AuthCallback -> POST /auth/google/session with X-Session-ID header; AuthContext skips /auth/me when hash contains session_id (prevents race); set_session_cookie uses SameSite=None + Secure + httpOnly; get_current_user accepts cookie OR Bearer; session_token also returned in response body for SPA Bearer usage.

STAFF_EMAILS allowlist is correctly enforced for BOTH password login (server.py:299) and Google session (server.py:322), returning 403 with 'team members' message. Owner vsv.visakhapatnam@gmail.com is in the allowlist.

Google session endpoint correctly reuses existing user (by email) and updates missing photo from Google 'picture'; new users default to role=seeker (not auto-admin), which combined with the pre-staff-gate at line 322 means non-staff Google users are blocked BEFORE any DB write — good.
Minor: AuthCallback.jsx uses an empty catch block (line 25). Consider logging the error for debugging, though behavior (redirect to /login) is correct.
test_credentials: admin: vsv.visakhapatnam@gmail.com / DentalHub@2026 (staff allowlist). Google OAuth consent screen NOT exercised interactively (per instructions). Fake session_ids used to verify 401 branch and AuthCallback redirect behavior.

The real Google consent flow cannot be automated — only the backend 400/401/403 branches, routing, and session management are testable. Combined with iteration_2 (test_security_fixes.py 13/13) the full auth surface is green.
